text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, May 12 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 6 vessels due by 23/5, no delays.
Hay Point - Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 13 due by 30/5, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Berth vacant, 19 vessels due by 27/5, no delays.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - No.1 shiploader under repairs until 22.00 hrs. 13/5. 1 Vessel loading, 25 due by 16/6, no delays.
Barney Point - Berth vacant, 5 vessels due by 4/6, no delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant, 1 vessel due 31/5, no delays.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Port closed to inward and selected outward movements due to high swell. Next inspection 06.30 hrs. 13/5. Congestion due to growing coal demand expected to worsen May/June.
Kooragang - 1 Vessel loading, 17 due by 27/5, 10-11 days delay expected. Dykes 4+5 - Berth vacant, 12 vessels waiting, 25 due by 27/5, 10-12 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 18 due by 5/8, 2 days delay expected.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Due to occasional shortages of Mt. Newman lump/fines and yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some berthing/loading delays or be forced to berth out of turn. Vessels May be further delayed due to heavy rain. A berth - 1 Vessel berthed, 6 anchored, 5 due by 22/5. B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored, 6 due by 21/5, 3 others due by 26/5, no eta received.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored.
East Intercourse island - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored.

Dampier line-up - 3 Vessels anchored (2 for Parker Point, 1 for East Intercourse island). 11 Due by 23/5 (4 for Parker Point, 7 for East Intercourse island). Parker Point will be closed for 5 days from 18/5.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 5 anchored, 9 due by 31/5.
